subject: info-doc
title: INFO.DOC.------TR.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 112 (T(AF)M-16). INFO-DOC (information documentation) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; TR-INFO (trans-information) is the partner. From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and TRS (transition). From T-C-IMP: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From PHY-U-P: AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and POL-DY (political dynamics). From AF-DY: ATTN (attraction), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From ATTN: AF-TD (affinity tendencies), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of".
